title: Check your demerit points
summary: Check your demerit points online for free to view your current driving record details.
intro:
You can check your demerits points online for free.

The demerit points check shows:

You can only see details of your own driver licence.

### Driving record

If you need a record of your driving history for an employer or a legal matter you can request a driving record.

The driving record includes any offences recorded against your licence. A fee applies to requests for information.

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account. Enter your NSW Driver Licence or vehicle registration details if your account is new or you have not previously entered them.

faqs.q: What does the demerit points check show?
faqs.a: The demerit points check only shows details of your own driver licence.

faqs.q: Do I need a record of my driving history for work or legal reasons?
faqs.a: Yes, if you need a record of your driving history for an employer or a legal matter, you can request a driving record. Note that a fee applies to these requests.
Demerit points are added to your driving record, and you will also be charged with a fine.
